_help: Edit values here, not in notebooks. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_snapshot_date_note: Month-end used for current balances, WAR, account-level reports and the legacy beta joins.

sources._note: Read-only production inputs. Change only if a source table is renamed.
sources._src_lsnv_dp_history_note: SNV deposit history (used by 999_source_lineage and truncation vintage analysis).

legacy._note: Legacy (Empyrean) products and betas, notebook 06a. PNFP accounts link to an Empyrean AccountNum through src_emp_ftp_results (acct_grp_nbr = accountid without its first letter, first letter of SecID = that letter); SNV accounts use ALMAccountNum in src_lsnv_nmds. AccountNum then joins inputs/reference/legacy_betas_pnfp.csv / legacy_betas_snv.csv.
legacy._ftp_results_date_note: Month-end (yyyy-mm-dd) of src_emp_ftp_results to link PNFP accounts. Blank = snapshot_date.
legacy._old_beta_field_note: Which legacy beta becomes OLD BETA: EmpyreanModelBeta, SuggestedBeta or CalculatedBeta (balance-weighted over each product's accounts). A blank value falls back to SuggestedBeta.
legacy._overwrite_old_betas_note: N = 06a only fills blank old_beta rows in inputs/reference/old_betas.csv (your own entries stay). Y = replace every row with the legacy value.

_pnfp_include_internal_note: Y = internal accounts stay in the study as 'Internal Deposits'; N = drop them (the older study behaviour).
_source_tables_note: production = 01 reads src_lsnv_nmds / src_pnfp_deposits; study = 01 reads the lsnv_dp_hist / lpnfp_dp_hist tables 00a_source_lineage builds from the raw files (build_sources = tables).
_dp_history_end_date_note: Last month 00a_source_lineage reads from the history / WAL Deps files. Blank = the newest file.

truncation._note: Truncation (account decay) analysis, notebooks 10 and 11. Products come from this study's current mapping (inputs/decisions/current) and mv_product_selection.
truncation._vintage_source_folder_note: Where the SNV <year>Vintage.csv files come from. 10 copies them into inputs/vintages/ the first time; after that the study copy is used.
truncation._vintage_years_note: SNV vintages in the cohort (2018Vintage.csv is also loaded; add 2018 here to include it).
truncation._baseline_note: Month 0 for each bank. PNFP cohort = accounts opened before pnfp_open_before, open and not internal.
truncation._max_n_month_note: Last N_Month used in the fit. Blank = the shorter bank's last month (so one bank running out does not look like decay).
truncation._snv_acquisition_note: SNV rows with AcquisitionID = 1 are always left out. Accounts first seen at snv_acquisition_month that opened before snv_unflagged_open_before are also left out (acquired accounts without the flag). Blank snv_acquisition_month = no extra exclusion.
truncation._curve_note: vintage_grain Month | Year. clock calendar_baseline (month 0 = the bank baseline) | vintage_age (month 0 = end of the vintage period). segment pooled | bank | bank_vintage. metric acct_cnt | eopbook | avgbook. 11 has widgets with these as defaults.
truncation._fit_note: fit_min_month = first N_Month in the fit; min_baseline_accts = groups with fewer month 0 accounts are not fitted; force_origin_at_100 Y = both fits start at 100%.
truncation._final_source_note: Final truncation per product in the Final Report. legacy = truncation_point from inputs/reference/legacy_truncations.csv (06a, balance-weighted over each product's legacy products); fit_30 / fit_25 / fit_20 = this study's linear fitted months to 30 / 25 / 20%; qfit_30 / qfit_25 / qfit_20 = the quadratic fit.
truncation.legacy_only_products: ICS IB DDA, ICS NIB DDA, NIB DDA Internal
truncation._legacy_only_products_note: Products with too few month 0 accounts for a curve: 11 leaves their fitted months blank and 09 uses the legacy truncation_point for them whatever final_source is.
truncation._levels_note: Groupings 11 fits. *_pf = broken out by public funds flag (e.g. MMA | PF N). 09 reads the mv_product level.

warf._note: WARF module, notebooks 12 (prep) and 13 (results). Month-end rows (eobm_flag = 'Y') of source_table, mapped to this study's products.
warf._dates_note: 12 loads months from start_date to end_date (yyyy-mm-dd). Blank end_date = the newest month in the source. Re-run 12 after changing.
warf._report_month_note: Month (yyyy-mm) for the single-month tables in 13. Blank = the newest month kept.
warf._exclude_months_note: Months (yyyy-mm, comma separated) 13 leaves out of every table and chart, e.g. 2025-12,2026-10.
warf._ops_months_only_note: Y = 13 keeps only months where BOTH banks have operational deposits loaded (op_deposit_flag = Y). Without them the source puts everything in the retail rollups and WARF is understated. N = keep every month.

wal._note: WAL module, notebook 15_wal_ftp. Empyrean account WALs (source_table) + FTP columns (sources.src_emp_ftp_results, same SecID and month) go into ONE shared history table (history_table, not versioned): 15 loads only months that are new or re-delivered. Each study maps every WAL month to its products with the SNAPSHOT product map (like betas), then builds the metric view mv_wal_<tag>.
wal._current_months_note: Current Assumption = the simple average of these months' WALs (each month weighted by average balance). Comma separated yyyy-mm-dd.
wal._calculated_month_note: Calculated = the WAL (weighted by average balance) of this month.
wal._reload_months_note: Months (yyyy-mm-dd, comma separated) 15 reloads into the history even if already loaded. Blank = only new or re-delivered months.

_mapping_source_note: REFERENCE = use inputs/reference/ files as-is; DERIVED = use the rules in 01 and snv_src.sql/pnfp_src.sql; REVIEWED = use current/ decisions.

report._note: Report exclusions. Brokered, Repo, Internal are not non-maturing deposits.
report._exclude_note: Comma-separated, case does not matter, * = any text (Brokered* matches Brokered, Brokered DDA and Brokered MMA). Blank = every product. A product is left out if its product group or its name matches. The Study Summary tab lists what was left out and its balance.

run_profiles._note: Named notebook sequences for selective runs (used by execute_study).
run_profiles._betas_note: After rate_cycles.csv, beta overrides or beta code changes. Mapping (01) and assignment (04) are not rebuilt.
run_profiles._reports_note: Only the report notebooks: for format or wording changes.
